baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 3-6 make God's signs the object of a taking construction whose assigned predicate is ridicule.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction is active and functional: evidentiary markers oriented toward worship are acquired and reassigned a contrary social use. The failure is therefore not mere inattention but deliberate semiotic repurposing.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate appropriation and the power to assign a new use.
A publicly legible marker supplies the evidentiary object that is being appropriated.
The worship relation fixes the signs' proper orientation and thereby sharpens the inversion.
Ridicule supplies the imposed social use that reverses the markers' evidentiary and devotional force.

changed_reading.before: They failed to respect God's signs.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately appropriated evidentiary markers and assigned them the social function of ridicule, reversing their worship-oriented use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 7-9 make proximate life the grammatical deceiver.
baseline_models.mechanism: Immediate life offers real benefit, but proximity and attractive surface are mistaken for completeness and durability. Its credibility comes from genuine usefulness; its deception lies in allowing the nearest horizon to claim exclusive explanatory priority.

activation_trace.role: An attractive but unstable surface supplies the lure that falsely presents itself as sufficient and durable.
Life understood as benefit and good supplies the real utility that makes the lure credible rather than wholly fictive.
Nearness supplies the attentional advantage of what is immediately available over what is remote.

changed_reading.after: Immediate benefit gained epistemic priority because proximity and surface appeal were mistaken for completeness and durability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal pivot at focus word 10 leads to coordinated denials of extraction at word 12 and restored acceptance at word 16.
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive event closes two routes at once: movement out of an enclosing state and the social-procedural route by which blame might be removed and acceptance recovered. The focus alone leaves the enclosure's referent underspecified.

activation_trace.role: A day understood as a grave event supplies a phase change rather than a neutral calendar label.
Passage from a state or place to its outside supplies the release that is categorically denied.

changed_reading.before: They remain punished and are not allowed to apologize.
changed_reading.after: The decisive event closes both release from an enclosing state and the procedural recovery of acceptance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same marker vocabulary spans the visible cosmos, recited discourse, and an earlier taking-to-ridicule construction. The focus accusation therefore names a transferable evidence-handling practice: heterogeneous disclosures are flattened into an unserious category before they can demand response.

activation_trace.role: The visible-marker sense anchors the focus object as evidence rather than a merely verbal token.
Deliberate acquisition supplies the stable handling operation applied to that evidence.
A marker visible in the cosmic setting broadens the evidence beyond recited language.
The two marker occurrences in a recitation setting add a verbally delivered evidence channel.
An earlier act of making the signs into something for oneself supplies a repeated appropriation pattern.
The earlier ridicule occurrence confirms the same imposed response category before the focus restatement.

structural_cues: The marker root recurs in cosmic, creaturely, recited, learned, and courtroom positions before the focus accusation repeats the taking-to-ridicule syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence across evidence channels and the repeated taking-to-ridicule construction; I infer one transferable suppression practice. A live alternative is cumulative culpability without a unified handling mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They converted God's signs into ridicule.
changed_reading.after: They used ridicule as a stable suppression practice that reclassified materially visible and verbally recited evidence alike before it could make a claim on them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first presents observable reanimation after death as a sign, then quotes a creed that admits living and dying while enclosing both within proximate life and extended time. Worldly deception is thus not denial of the observed cycle but closure of a true cycle into a self-sufficient ontology that excludes source, gathering, and judgment.

activation_trace.role: The unstable lure supplies the false claim of sufficiency imposed on otherwise real life processes.
Proximity supplies the boundary within which the admitted cycle is treated as exhaustive.
Earth's recovery through rain and growth supplies a concrete, observable return of vitality.
Loss of vitality supplies the prior state from which the observable recovery proceeds.
Animate existence supplies both occurrences in the quoted life-only account and marks what that account permits as real.
The nearer world supplies the explicit horizon to which the quoted account restricts life.
Extended time supplies the substitute causal frame that contains death without opening onto judgment.

structural_cues: The sequence at 45:5 runs provision to reanimation after death; 45:24 closes living and dying inside time, while 45:26 reopens the sequence toward gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a witnessed renewal cycle, the quoted life-only claim, and the later gathering sequence; I infer that deception consists in closing rather than fabricating the cycle. Alternatively, the focus may denote attachment to pleasures without this epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Near life deceived them through pleasure and distraction.
changed_reading.after: Near life deceived them by turning a genuine renewal pattern into a closed explanation: life and death were admitted, but source, gathering, and judgment were excluded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near and conspicuous acquires control of attention while hearing fails to become understanding and perceptual channels are sealed. Deception becomes an architecture of selective uptake: signs remain available, but foreground salience prevents them from reaching responsive judgment until hidden consequences become visible.

activation_trace.role: A conspicuous bright mark supplies the visual salience by which surface prominence captures attention.
Spatial and cognitive nearness supplies the foreground advantage of immediate life.
The signs remain overt markers, making the problem failed uptake rather than missing evidence.
Hearing as comprehension and response makes the paired hearing and as-if-not-hearing sequence a failed uptake channel.
A secured barrier supplies closure of the inward channels through which evidence would become responsive judgment.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the perceptual faculty whose availability does not guarantee insight.

structural_cues: At 45:23 hearing, heart, and sight are blocked in one sequence; at 45:33 the concealed consequences of deeds become apparent, reversing the earlier visibility regime.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, conspicuousness, overt signs, failed hearing, and sealed faculties; I infer an attention-capture mechanism. A live alternative is simple willful refusal with no special role for perceptual foregrounding.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life told them something false.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life captured the foreground: what was near and conspicuous monopolized uptake while overt signs failed to become inwardly effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated taking constructions install objects into governing roles: substitute patrons are adopted, inclination is installed as deity, and signs are assigned ridicule. The focus act can therefore be read as part of a rival allegiance system in which desire determines the status of evidence and demotes whatever challenges it.

activation_trace.role: Making something one's own supplies the focus act of installing a chosen relation to the signs.
Ridicule supplies the demoted role assigned to evidence that contests the chosen authority.
A context act of adoption supplies a parallel role-assignment construction involving substitute patrons.
Protective allegiance supplies the relational office expected from the adopted substitutes.
A second context act of adoption supplies the installation of an inward preference into an authoritative office.
Inclination of the self supplies the internal selector that decides which evidence is honored or demoted.
The worship office spanning the three occurrences makes the adopted inclination's rival authority explicit.

structural_cues: The repeated taking syntax moves through substitute patrons and inclination-as-deity before the focus assigns ridicule to signs; active role assignment later gives way to passive non-release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel adoption constructions, allegiance, inclination, worship, and ridicule; I infer a network of installed roles rather than unrelated offenses. Alternatively, each construction may be an independent example with no shared allegiance mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They adopted a mocking attitude toward the signs.
changed_reading.after: Making signs into ridicule was an allegiance act: inclination governed classification, substitute patrons promised support, and challenging evidence was demoted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an attempted argument, a summons to an individualized record, recompense, a record that gives evidence, and the copying of acts. The focus's denied restoration follows an evidentiary process; it reads as post-verdict finality rather than refusal to hear an initial defense.

activation_trace.role: The grave event supplies the procedural phase in which ordinary opportunities have ended.
Movement to the outside supplies the denied remedy that would alter the adjudicated state.
A contention meant to prevail supplies the defendants' earlier attempted evidentiary challenge.
A verbal summons supplies formal movement of each community into the adjudicative setting.
An inscription that establishes an obligation or ruling supplies the individualized record's binding force.
A response matched to an act supplies the verdict's act-for-consequence structure.
Evidence that communicates its own indication supplies the record's testimonial function.
Transfer of a written image into another record supplies continuity between performed acts and the evidence presented.

structural_cues: The un-inventoried ع ت ب form at focus word 16 is used only through its passive morphology and coordination with non-extraction; no branch is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenge, summons, binding record, matched recompense, testimony, and transcription; I infer procedural closure as the arrow to denied restoration. A live alternative is a nontechnical denial of appeasement after punishment begins.

changed_reading.before: They are simply denied a chance to apologize.
changed_reading.after: They are denied reopening after argument, summons, record, and matched judgment have already run their course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agency and spatial relation reverse. People first make signs into an object of ridicule; immediately before the focus, what they ridiculed becomes an encompassing consequence, and a fire-abode is named. The focus then shifts them into passive subjects who cannot be extracted from that enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Active appropriation supplies the initial relation in which people control the signs' assigned use.
Ridicule supplies the relation whose direction will be reversed by the surrounding consequence.
Passage to an outside supplies the now-impossible escape from the reversed relation.
A harmful consequence that descends and surrounds supplies the conversion of mocked object into enclosure.
The context ridicule occurrence identifies what had been held at a mocking distance before it surrounds them.
Joining a containing refuge or abode supplies the immediately preceding spatial container.
Burning fire identifies the abode and resolves the literal enclosure from which extraction is denied.

structural_cues: At 45:33 the mocked matter becomes the subject of an encompassing verb; 45:34 names fire as abode immediately before the feminine pronoun and passive non-extraction in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, surrounding harm, fire-abode, and denied exit; I infer a reversal in which the ridiculed evidence returns as enclosing consequence and link the pronoun to the adjacent abode. The live alternative keeps only the local fire antecedent without the conceptual reversal.

changed_reading.before: They mocked signs and are then kept in an unspecified punishment.
changed_reading.after: The relation reverses: what they held off as ridicule becomes an encompassing consequence, and the adjacent fire-abode is the enclosure from which they are not extracted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the near horizon made the future encounter discardable. The immediately preceding reciprocal-neglect formula then turns temporal neglect into relational consequence: at the decisive encounter, release and renewed acceptance are no longer solicited.

activation_trace.role: The unstable lure supplies the pressure under which the future encounter was treated as unreal or dispensable.
Nearness supplies the temporal preference that displaced the remote encounter.
The severe event supplies the moment when deferred relation becomes unavoidable.
The paired event occurrences bind present consequence to the formerly neglected encounter.
Deliberate leaving or neglect across both occurrences supplies the explicit reciprocal relation.
Two parties coming face to face supplies the encounter whose neglect is now reversed.

structural_cues: The explicit comparison at 45:34 pairs present neglect with their prior neglect, and the focus coordinates passive non-extraction with the un-inventoried restoration form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-life lure, paired neglect, encounter, and the decisive event; I infer that denied restoration is the procedural expression of reciprocal abandonment. Alternatively, the comparison may mark retribution without implying relational withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: They cannot regain favor once punishment begins.
changed_reading.after: No restoration is the endpoint of reciprocal neglect: they discarded the future encounter for the near horizon, and the decisive encounter closes their bid for renewed acceptance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote mount-motion branch of the focus ridicule root and links it to the context's harnessed ship movement. It remains anchored in the focus taking-plus-ridicule construction and a coherent context motion sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for instrumentalizing revelation, never as a lexical translation of ridicule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 3 and 6 permit an exploratory image in which an acquired object is set in motion for the user's purpose.

activation_trace.role: Making something one's own supplies possession and control of the imagined instrument.
The remote act of setting a mount in motion supplies the vehicle image for instrumentalized signs.
Subduing and directing something toward a purpose supplies the context's explicit harnessing mechanism.
Flowing movement supplies the trajectory produced by the harnessed vehicle.
A vessel moving on water supplies the concrete carrier that stabilizes the analogy.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they harnessed the signs as a vehicle for their own trajectory, making revelation carry their motion instead of redirecting it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates material fold and template senses under the focus deception root. It remains anchored in that root and is sharpened by the context's copied record of intentional acts. Downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for habituation and reproducibility, not replace the ordinary sense of deception with textile language.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 7 can carry a material analogy in which repeated conduct takes a durable fold or governing pattern.

activation_trace.role: A visible fold-mark supplies the material trace left by repeated worldly orientation.
A governing mold or single course supplies the repeatable behavioral pattern formed by that orientation.
Copying a written image into a record supplies faithful reproduction of the formed pattern.
Intentional action supplies the repeated conduct that creates the pattern and is later reproduced.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life deceived them in a moment of misjudgment.
changed_reading.after: Worldly orientation repeatedly folded conduct into a template, and judgment's record reproduced the resulting behavioral crease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the adjacent context strongly favors fire as the literal antecedent of the no-exit pronoun. It remains thematically anchored in the focus's nearest feminine life-noun and the denied-exit branch. Downstream prose must preserve fire as the grammatical reading and offer inescapable near-life only as a secondary conceptual echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 8-9 name proximate life before word 12 denies extraction from a feminine enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Life as experienced benefit supplies the horizon that was treated as exhaustive.
Nearness supplies the enclosing horizon beyond which the deceived reading refused to look.
Movement from inside to outside supplies the denied transcendence of that horizon.
A containing abode supplies the literal antecedent environment that limits the outlier to thematic echo.
Burning fire identifies the literal enclosure and prevents the exploratory echo from displacing the local reading.

changed_reading.before: The no-exit pronoun points only to the fire named immediately before the focus.
changed_reading.after: Under the literal fire referent, the clause also echoes a trap: the proximate life they made exhaustive has become a conceptual horizon they cannot transcend.

strongest_changes: The life-and-death context turns generic worldly distraction into epistemic closure: a true renewal cycle is treated as all that exists.
The judgment sequence makes denied restoration post-record procedural finality rather than a first refusal to hear.
The ridicule relation reverses into enclosure, while the immediately preceding fire-abode resolves the literal source of non-extraction.
The repeated sign vocabulary broadens the focus from mockery of one message to suppression of visible, recited, and forensic evidence channels.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one synthesis: semiotic repurposing, rival allegiance, perceptual foreground capture, closed-world explanation, procedural finality, reciprocal neglect, and a spatial reversal in which mocked evidence becomes enclosing consequence. Remote material branches also preserved vehicle and crease analogies without promoting them to translations.
remaining_uncertainties: Taking-as-mockery may be a shared rival-allegiance mechanism or simply one active misuse among several parallel offenses.
The arrows from proximity to attention capture and from ridicule to enclosure are reader-supplied, although the packet's sequences visibly support them.
The missing ع ت ب inventory prevents branch-level discrimination among apology, appeasement, and restored acceptance; only morphology and coordination support that side of the closure models.
The near-life no-exit reading is thematic only; the adjacent fire-abode remains the strong literal antecedent.
